The internal energy of n moles of a gas is U=12nFRT

Total internal energy =U1+U2=11RT

⇒x=11

Inserting the numerical values; p0 = 1.00 atm, T0 = 293.15 K(t0 = 20oC),

 T1 = 373.15 K(t1 = 100oC), and T2 = 237.15 K(t2 = 0oC),
